notes_zh:
- **新增** 图片预览缩放：长图、大图可在面板内按宽度自适应或 1:1 原始大小查看，鼠标移到预览区右下角会浮现工具栏（切换适应/原始、在"预览"中打开）（#55，感谢 @bingoohuang 的贡献）
- **新增** 自定义快捷键支持 Esc 与修饰键组合（例如 ⌘+Esc）（#51，感谢 @yguangbxiu 的反馈）
notes_en:
- **New** Zoomable image preview: long or large images can be viewed at fit-to-window or 1:1 actual size; a toolbar (toggle fit/actual, open in Preview) appears on hover in the bottom-right of the preview area (#55, thanks @bingoohuang for the contribution)
- **New** Allow Esc as part of custom shortcuts when combined with modifier keys (e.g. ⌘+Esc) (#51, thanks @yguangbxiu for the report)
